questions.question: In your current Senior Accountant role, how do you perform monthly variance analysis against budget, forecast, and prior-year results, and how do you communicate the key drivers to leadership?
Describe a complex account reconciliation you improved. What was unclear or inefficient about the prior process, what changes did you make, and what was the result?
This role supports program leaders with budgeting, forecasting, and scenario planning. Can you walk us through a financial model or set of metrics you built to explain account or operational drivers?
Tell us about a time you identified a material processing inaccuracy affecting revenue or financial reporting. How did you investigate it, correct it, and prevent recurrence?
What has been your role in month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes, including account analysis, journal entries, and financial review meetings?
Describe your experience supporting internal or external audits. How have you addressed audit findings or deficiencies and prepared supporting schedules or documentation?
The position requires strong internal-control awareness. Can you provide an example of a control you evaluated, redesigned, eliminated, or documented, including the rationale and outcome?
How would you approach analyzing a nonprofit program’s budget-to-actual results when it has multiple funding streams, personnel costs, and direct program expenses?
Tell us about your experience working across departments or with operational stakeholders to obtain financial data, resolve issues, or improve reporting visibility.

This position requires advanced Excel skills for analysis and reporting. Which Excel tools, models, macros, pivot tables, or other techniques have you used to improve accuracy, efficiency, or decision-making?
